title: Kim Petras Presents Elizabeth Matthews With the Executive of the Year Award | Billboard Women In Music 2026
summary: Kim Petras presents Elizabeth Matthews with the Executive of the Year Award at Billboard Women In Music 2026. At the Hollywood Palladium on Wednesday night (April 29), Billboard Women in Music 2026 is honoring EJAE, REI AMI, AUDREY NUNA, Kehlani, Teyana Taylor, Ella Langley, Thalia, Zara Larsson, Laufey and Tate McRae.
